note: RERUN1 of jit-hot-reserve-correct-1117 on ts3native.asi.yalias-1117 (0.36.274-yalias2). The first run (bp-hotres-correct, chain-1117i) never saw Motive.UpdateMotiveWithDecay: ts3fixes motivemultonce (on by default in dalexlol-1117b) swaps its body, so EA's body runs as Motive.DecayOrig and the Y key never transformed (jitHotKB 1800 to the end, 2147 general compiles held). The fix matches the swap stub as the same Y key (same IL hash check); the compile, release and jitcount yrow lines may name Motive.DecayOrig. REPINNED 11-17 to ts3native.asi.hotres2-1117 (0.36.273-hotres2 on master: gchold2 set + YRows + HotReserve), ini hotres2-1117, ts3fixes dalexlol-1117b. jit-hot-reserve-correct-1117 (PREPARED, NOT RUN; correctness class, docs/537 §32): [MonoJit] HotReserve keeps one YRows body's room (code-region bound 1800 KB with Direct + Count=1, a method slot, 1792 positions) free from general compiles until Motive.UpdateMotiveWithDecay compiles, at the shipped CodeKB=8192 / MaxMethods=4096 (m2-motive-correct rerun1: "code region full" at 8188 of 8192 KB, 4080 methods). Pass = the hot-reserve line, the uncapped compile line of the method, the release line naming it compiled, a jitcount yrow line with entries > 0, no refusal of it, jitHotKB 0 at the end, MISMATCH / faults 0, script errors 0. Household: the compiled body is exact for every Sim (docs/537 §31), so household untouched = jitMismatch 0 + jitFaults 0 + script errors 0. Supersedes m2-motive-correct-1116-rerun2-1117 (CodeKB=16384 workaround, +8 MB address space); that queue's "^jit: compiled .*UpdateMotiveWithDecay \(" regex cannot match the real line ("NAME: N positions") and m2y1117 caps compile lines at 256.
